checks.reason: Does not prospectively define the roles and comparisons of an active-assay positive, vehicle/background negative and necessary procedural controls; generic suitable controls or an ATP comparison alone are incomplete.

checks.reason: No plan to consult prior experimental Methods/supplements or validated protocols and check condition transfer before executing follow-up assays. Bibliographic authentication does not meet this distinct requirement.

checks.quote: quantitatively consistent with, and arguably predicted by

checks.quote: quantitatively consistent with, and arguably predicted by
checks.reason: The proposed measurement lacks a complete quantitative endpoint with units/denominator, background and weak/saturated/missing-signal rules.

Failed inhibition in one unvalidated fragment assay cannot disprove direct inhibition or uniquely attribute the cellular effect to bioenergetics. ATP rescue also does not exclude a simultaneous ribosomal target.

The fragment assay lacks a validated donor-loading/product-identity comparison and independent detection or function controls; listing radioactive donor and puromycin is insufficient to resolve assay competence and target assignment.

checks.quote: Prevents independent retrieval and version tracking
checks.reason: Lack of a supplied DOI does not prevent independent retrieval/version tracking through institutional, publisher or archival identifiers.

checks.quote: quantitatively consistent with, and arguably predicted by
checks.reason: A 50% ATP pool decline does not quantitatively predict a 60% translation decline; no kinetic, per-live-cell or temporal model establishes that causal magnitude.

checks.quote: No cell-free or purified-component assay exists
checks.reason: No assay is available in the packet; it is not established that none exists.
